title: Playwright Auto Healer Fix: Error: Transaction amount field should show "10.40 USD"
body:
## Fix: withdrawal transaction detail now splits "Amount" into "Amount withdrawn" / "Amount received"

**Group:** `ui-change-8295c5785b3c` — "Transaction amount field should show \"10.40 USD\"" (6 candidates)
**Spec:** `cashier/withdraw/verify-usd-withdraw-to-credit-card.spec.ts`
**Test:** `Cashier — Withdraw › VERIFY USD withdrawal to saved card deducts balance after completing the withdrawal flow`

### Root cause

`PortfolioPage.verifyWithdrawalTransactionDetails()` asserted a single detail-panel row
labelled exactly `"Amount"`. The product transaction-detail panel
(`src/features/portfolio/components/wallet-transactions-sidebar.tsx`) now splits that row into
two when a withdrawal carries a processing fee (`isWalletWithdrawalWithFee`,
`wallet-tx-helpers.ts:351-360`):

- **"Amount withdrawn"** — gross amount debited (e.g. `10.40 USD`)
- **"Amount received"** — net payout amount (e.g. `10.00 USD`)

This is an intentional, documented UX change (doc comment at `wallet-tx-helpers.ts:344-349`:
*"Detail shows Amount withdrawn (gross) + Amount received (net) with the fee tooltip"*), not a
regression — confirmed visually from the CI screenshot/accessibility snapshot for the failing
run, which shows a fully-rendered (not loading/skeleton) panel with both rows present and the
expected `10.40 USD` value already showing under "Amount withdrawn". The old locator
(`getByText('Amount', { exact: true })`) simply no longer matches any row once the fee-bearing
withdrawal path renders, so the assertion timed out waiting for an element that will never exist
in that state.

### Fix

- Added `transactionDetailsAmountWithdrawnField` locator to `playwright/pages/PortfolioPage.ts`
  (mirrors the existing `transactionDetailsAmountReceivePrimaryField` pattern).
- `verifyWithdrawalTransactionDetails()` now branches on whether a processing fee applies
  (`totalDebited !== amount`):
  - **Fee present:** assert `"Amount withdrawn"` shows the gross total and `"Amount received"`
    shows the net amount.
  - **No fee:** unchanged — asserts the single `"Amount"` field, preserving prior behaviour for
    any future no-fee withdrawal coverage.

This fix applies to every candidate in the group sharing this signature (webkit-mobile ×2,
webkit, chromium-mobile) — they all fail at the same `PortfolioPage.ts` line via the same stale
locator, driven by the same product change.

### Not in scope (different failure signatures in this group)

Two candidates in this group have unrelated root causes and are **not** addressed by this
change:
- Firefox run (counter 6755): balance-mismatch assertion — post-withdrawal balance was off by
  exactly one extra debit, consistent with a retry re-submitting a non-idempotent withdrawal
  rather than a UI/locator issue.
- Chromium run (counter 6753): saved card not visible in the withdraw iframe dropdown — an
  earlier-stage iframe/payment-provider issue, unrelated to the transaction-detail panel.

The group's auto-regroup reasoning hypothesized these cascade from one root cause, but the
CI evidence (screenshots + attempt-by-attempt error history) shows the "10.40 USD" signature
candidates reach and fully render the transaction detail page — the failure is isolated to the
stale locator fixed here.

### Verification

```
npx playwright test playwright/tests/cashier/withdraw/verify-usd-withdraw-to-credit-card.spec.ts \
  --project=chromium-mobile \
  --grep "VERIFY USD withdrawal to saved card deducts balance after completing the withdrawal flow"
```

Result: **1 passed** (previously failing with the group's signature error on this spec/project
combination class).

`webkit` / `webkit-mobile` projects were not runnable in this sandbox (browser binary not
installed), but they exercise the identical `PortfolioPage.ts` code path and locator, so the
chromium-mobile pass verifies the fix for the whole group.

### Files changed

- `playwright/pages/PortfolioPage.ts` (unstaged)

> [!NOTE]
> This PR was opened after the healer agent's sample Playwright CLI verification (pass, or original signature fixed with an unrelated/downstream failure). Review the diff before merging.
